sources.label: Morphe patches for the bol.com app
sources.author: Wouter's bol
patch_list: Required for a patched (re-signed) app: skips the Google Play license check that would otherwise close the app.
Disables analytics and tracking: RudderStack, AppsFlyer, Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance, Sentry, Airship analytics and the advertising id. Push notifications keep working.
Removes sponsored products from search results, the sponsored and advertisement sections on product pages, and the display ad banners on the home, search and category pages.
